name: IEW World Heavyweight Championship
notes: Vacant at the promotion's 2002 return and decided by a fourteen-man tournament.
epitaph: The top title of IEW, vacant at its 2002 return and decided by a fourteen-man tournament whose final at Awakening, 17 March 2002, Tom Tombstone won over Jared Sengir. One reign is recorded.

name: IEW North American Championship
epitaph: A secondary IEW title, vacant at its 2002 return, won by 'Simply Electric' Eli Johnson in a battle royal on Monday Metal, 25 February 2002, and kept by him in a three-way Hell in the Cell at Awakening. One reign is recorded.

name: IEW Women's Championship
epitaph: IEW's women's title, long vacant before Little Buff beat Christina Mazing for it on Monday Metal, 25 February 2002; she kept it in a three-way at Awakening. One reign is recorded.

name: IEW Extreme Championship
epitaph: An IEW title fought under extreme rules, won by 'The Extremist' Adam Richardz in a three-way dance at Awakening, 17 March 2002. One reign is recorded.

name: IEW World Tag Team Championship
epitaph: IEW's tag team title, won single-handed by Jason Craven over the Jekel Brothers at Awakening, 17 March 2002. One reign is recorded.
